दृंह् दृंह् (connected and sometimes
identified with rt. दृह्), cl. 1. P. दृंहति,
ददृंह, दृंहितुम्, to make firm, fix, strengthen,
confirm; to make fast, fasten; to fortify; cl. 1. A.
दृंहते, to be firm or fixed; to grow, increase:
Caus. दृंहयति, -यितुम्: Desid. दिदृंहिषति:
Intens. दरीदृंह्यते.

दृंहण, अम्, n., Ved. making firm or fast,
strengthening, fastening, fortifying; means of strength-
ening; [cf. केश-द्˚.]

दृंहित, अस्, आ, अम्, made firm or fast, fixed,
strengthened, fortified; grown, increased.

दृंहितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who makes firm,
a strengthener.

दृन् दृन्, ind. an interjection; (probably
an artificial word made to explain दृन्भू, q. v.)

दृन्फू दृन्फू or दृन्भू, ऊस्, m. (said to
be fr. rt. दृम्फ् or दृम्प्, q. v.), a thunderbolt;
the sun; f. a snake in general; a wheel; [cf. दृग्-
